meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，当用户询问 claude-mem 的工作原理时，Claude 会解释它如何捕获观察（将每次 Read、Edit、Bash 压缩为观察）、何时自动注入记忆（从第二个会话起），以及数据存储位置（均在本机 ~/.claude-mem）。
howto.when: 当用户提出“claude-mem 如何工作？”或“这是做什么的？”等类似问题时触发。

say.note: Claude 会解释观察捕获与记忆注入机制。

say.text: 这个 claude-mem 在做什么？
say.note: Claude 会说明其运行方式。
Claude 会告知存储位置和卸载方式。

howto.what_en: When asked how claude-mem works, Claude explains that it compresses each Read/Edit/Bash into observations, auto-injects relevant ones from the second session onward, and keeps data in ~/.claude-mem.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks 'how does claude-mem work?' or 'what is this thing doing?'.

say_en.note: Claude explains observation capture and injection.
Claude tells the location and uninstall.
